note: Hard red-flag floor for triage. Keywords and text are normalised the same way (lowercase, accents and Arabic hamza/harakat stripped, ى->ي, ة->ه, Arabic-Indic digits -> ASCII). A string keyword is a substring; {"all": [...]} needs every term somewhere; {"regex": ...} runs on the normalised text; a term {"context": "elderly"} holds for age 75+ or an elderly clue in the text; "affirm": true keeps an inability phrase valid inside a negation. A hit under a negation cue is ignored (see triage.py). Flags marked provisional are illustrative and must be confirmed by the hospital's doctors. Errs towards raising urgency. Not clinically validated.
